findings.description: Three global variable references (MEN, MTR, PN) are missing definitions. Line 67 in app.js uses MEN.filter(), line 102 in views.js uses MTR.filter(), and multiple views use PN[...] to look up parish names. They should be aliased to menteesN, mentors, and ParishName respectively. Will crash when user clicks 'Add mentee friends' or 'Get in touch with a mentor'.
